in_sanskrit.name: तत्वन्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The One with a unique essence

in_marathi.name: Tatvanya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Truth and wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tatvanya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tatvanya is derived from two words, 'Tatva' and 'Anaya'. 'Tatva' means truth or reality and 'Anaya' means 'indefinite feminine suffix'. Together, it signifies the one who possesses truth and wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Tatvanya

'Tatva' means truth or reality and 'Anaya' means 'indefinite feminine suffix'. Together, it signifies the one who possesses truth and wisdom.
